verdict.line: You lose if you let Kled stick with E (Jousting) and burn you down with W (Violent Tendencies) while Skaarl's HP buffer is full; you win if you poke that buffer down and cash in Mega Gnar's stun once Kled dismounts.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire threat level is gated by Skaarl's separate health bar — mounted, he trades evenly or better using E (Jousting) dash resets and W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed bursts because Skaarl absorbs the damage instead of Kled's own HP. Gnar's long-range Q (Boomerang Throw, 1100 range) and bouncing E (Hop) let him chip that bar from outside Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range) without ever entering melee. Once Skaarl's bar empties, Kled dismounts into a champion that deals less damage and loses his hook for the far weaker Pocket Pistol — and if you've banked max Rage by then, Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stun turns that moment into a kill.

theirWindow.when: Kled mounted, Skaarl's HP still full
theirWindow.what: He can freely threaten E (Jousting) dash-resets and W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed bursts because Skaarl eats the damage instead of Kled. Stay outside his 550-range E and 800-range Q and only trade with Q (Boomerang Throw) pokes.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl dismounted, or you're Mega Gnar
yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and swaps his hook for the weaker Pocket Pistol — this is the all-in window. If you've also hit max Rage, Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stun locks him down for E (Crunch) and R (GNAR!) to finish the trade.

start.why: Sustain and a bit of early trade damage let you answer Kled's Skaarl-buffered all-ins without losing the sustain war; it's the stronger measured start here (52.1% win rate, 57.1% pick rate).

boots.why: Flat physical damage reduction directly blunts Kled's W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed burst and his sustained auto-attack damage once he commits to melee range (53.3% win rate, 90.4% pick rate).

core.why: The move-speed and on-hit damage spike lets you kite Kled's E (Jousting) range while still punishing any stray stick with empowered Q (Boomerang Throw) pokes.
Shred armor to make your poke and Mega Gnar burst actually kill Skaarl's HP buffer faster instead of just chipping it.
The bonus health and tenacity-adjacent survivability matter once Kled lands his Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) yank or lines up a Jousting double-dash all-in.

situational.when: kled keeps resetting fights with jousting dashes and chunking you with crit-style burst
kled or his team builds lifesteal and you need to shut down sustain through fights
kled's team adds ap damage and you need magic resist alongside more attack speed

runes.keystoneWhy: The heal-on-move procs reward kiting Kled's melee range while Q (Boomerang Throw) poke chips Skaarl's HP bar, matching this page's 48.3% win rate and 34.5% pick rate in the matchup.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset after shoving Skaarl's HP down with poke and still make it back for objectives (65.5% pick, 54.5% win rate); Flash is mandatory to dodge Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) or cut off an E (Jousting) all-in. Flash+Ignite is the sharper alternative (66.7% win rate) if you're playing to force an early dismount rather than scale the lane out.

playing.title: Stay Outside 800 Range
playing.detail: Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) only reaches 800 — hover past that line and only step in to land a Q (Boomerang Throw) from your own 1100 range.

playing.title: Poke, Don't Melee
playing.detail: Throw and retreat. Dueling in melee lets Skaarl's buffer and his W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed burst win the exchange for him.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's HP Bar
playing.detail: Every trade should specifically target the mount bar, not Kled's champion HP — once Skaarl's bar hits zero, his damage to champions drops and his kit weakens.

playing.title: Bank Rage Before Committing
playing.detail: Fight through poke exchanges so you hit max Rage and transform mid-trade — turning a simple poke exchange into a Mega Gnar W (Wallop) stun window.

playing.title: Respect the Double Dash
playing.detail: Kled's E (Jousting) can recast to dash back through you, so don't commit your own E (Hop) into him expecting a free follow-up — he can escape or re-engage on the return pass.

playing.title: Punish Remount Attempts
playing.detail: Kled rebuilds courage by fighting, so don't tunnel one dismounted trade and walk away — full disengage lets him remount with HP back for free.

playing.title: Consider Lethal Tempo
playing.detail: Master-tier Gnar players run Lethal Tempo over Fleet Footwork (60.9% win rate across 1,842 games) — it suits players who want to force early all-ins and burst Skaarl down rather than win a long poke war.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, rune pages, and summoner spells above are pulled from measured Gnar vs Kled games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — why the Skaarl HP bar and the Rage transform are the levers that decide this lane — is my own read of the kit, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Cut Down while avoiding his (Q). Kite him often to force him to dismount Skaal. You have the upper hand if he does not have Skaal.
